buyers.minimum: None stated. Submitting the form is not an offer; owner replies by email within 24 hours and may refuse any offer (e.g. if already overloaded with bulk).
buyers.shipping: Seller pays shipping to TCGBK. If you need help the owner "may be able to set you up with a shipping label, the cost of which will be deducted from your eventual payout." Local sellers (Tucson, AZ) can say so in the form.
buyers.condition_rules: Near Mint only. Packing guide: line every surface of the box with bubble wrap, pack tightly, tape all edges. Submissions packed without these precautions are still accepted but cards below Near Mint on arrival are not paid. TCGBK may adjust payout for the condition cards arrive in.
buyers.sorting_rules: Seller counts cards per category on the submission form; categories listed per game (see rates). Bricks do not need to be wrapped in team bags. Audit within 48 hours of receipt, then a final offer is sent.
buyers.excluded: Pokemon: Japanese cards have their own (lower) lines; Weiss Schwarz English vs Japanese separate; anything not on the form is "Price TBD" (e.g. other TCGs, Dragon Ball, Gundam not listed).
buyers.turnaround: Reply to submission within 24 hours; audit within 48 hours of receipt; then seller picks PayPal, store credit (+30%) or return at seller expense. Payout timing after that not stated.
buyers.process: Online submission form (name, email, payout choice, counts per category, notes) via the "Sell Your Bulk" page; ships after owner email reply. No account stated as required for the form.
buyers.rates_last_updated: Comparison table "accurate as of 1/10/2026" (owner blog 2026-01-11); form undated
buyers.reputation: Owner-operated, "A Go2Eleven Games company"; owner disclosed in Jan 2026 that site emails (incl. bulk-submission notifications) had been failing since ~June 2025, apologising for missed submissions. Sells bulk lots and is also a TCGplayer/eBay seller.

notes: Compiled 2026-10-20 from the six pages provided plus every page they link to or cite. Rates are in USD per card unless unit says otherwise; EUR/GBP/CAD/AUD on non-US TCG Bulk buyers carry their own 'currency'. PAGE 1 tcgbulkkings.com/projects/: TCG Bulk Kings' own rates (submission-form lines) plus a comparison table of ~16 other buyers (dated 2026-01-10, 9 months old; several numbers verified wrong vs the buyers' own pages today). PAGE 2 app.tcgbulk.com: Angular SPA; the public API https://api.tcgbulk.com/company/buyers-bulk/?page=N&limit=25 lists 375 buyers (150 on the market), and /company/<slug> returns each buyer's per-rarity rates. 150 on-market buyers are included below ('(via TCG Bulk)'); 225 off-market accounts were listed but not fetched (see provided_sites_tcgbulk_offmarket.json). TCG Bulk charges sellers a 10% service fee and optional 3.5% insurance; seller pays shipping; PayPal payout. Many TCG Bulk accounts are new with 0-5 completed submissions; see 'reputation'. PAGE 3 monsterandshield.com blog: a comparison of 9 other buyers (store itself closed bulk on 2026-10-01); each cited buyer has its own entry and was re-checked on its own site (all except Troll and Toad, which needs a browser). PAGE 4 metatcg.com, PAGE 5 tabletopvillage.com, PAGE 6 collectorsemporium.com: complete first-party tables captured.
